_about: Template for the local, untracked config/callers.json — copy it there and replace the sample caller ids with the threads this workspace actually runs. A caller is the named thread doing the work, claimed at the wrapper seams (--caller flag, or $COLAB_CALLER for drivers) and validated against this registry; the machinery callers (panel, standing, test, lease) are code constants and never listed here. A caller may carry one lane suffix (alpha-thread:lane-1) validated against its registered base. The optional "active" list marks registered callers whose work is detached-only: active means a potential use for Colab exists for that caller even when no session is currently up, and while a caller is marked active the sync gate refuses its synchronous attaches outright — it launches detached and polls instead.
